title: AI Group-Chat Startup Wabi Raises $55M at $1.25B Valuation
summary:
The company building a multiplayer AI assistant for group messenger threads secured a fresh round of funding led by IVP. The $55 million investment values Wabi at $1.25 billion as it expands its tool that can book appointments, coordinate schedules and create small applications such as meal plans and trackers for group chats.

Wabi opened its product to the general public on Oct. 19 following a pivot from its original focus as an app builder. The valuation comes during a period of high investment in the agent sector, including a $108 million Series B for TownAI and a $1 billion round for Instinct in September.

Another huge round in agent land!

@wabi raised $55M led by @IVP at a $1.25B val  

Wabi is a multiplayer personal AI agent that works like a messenger. You add friends + family to threads, and the agent plans, coordinates, handles everyday tasks, & builds mini apps (trackers, meal plans, games) for the group

No real stats on the biz from press, but it only opened to the public on Oct 19, a few weeks after pivoting from an app builder

Follows some other big recent agent rounds: 
> @instinct raising another $1B at a $10B val in Sept
> @TownAI raising a $108M Series B at a $1B val last week
> Tolan raising $30M led by @usv last week
